passage.text: Mr. Brown gave Nam, Ploy, Beam and Kong a group project: a presentation about a problem in Bangkok.
passage.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn ˈɡeɪv ˈnɑːm, ˈplɔɪ, ˈbiːm ənd ˈkɔːŋ ə ˈɡruːp ˈprɑːdʒɛkt: ə ˌprɛzənˈteɪʃən əˈbaʊt ə ˈprɑːbləm ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk.

passage.text: They met in the library to choose a topic.
passage.reading: ðeɪ ˈmɛt ɪn ðə ˈlaɪbrɛri tə ˈtʃuːz ə ˈtɑːpɪk.

passage.text: "Let's do traffic," said Beam. "Everyone hates traffic jams."
passage.reading: ˈlɛts ˈduː ˈtræfɪk, ˈsɛd ˈbiːm. ˈɛvriwʌn ˈheɪts ˈtræfɪk ˌdʒæmz.

passage.text: "But traffic is so boring," said Ploy. "What about street food? Is it safe to eat?"
passage.reading: bʌt ˈtræfɪk ɪz soʊ ˈbɔːrɪŋ, ˈsɛd ˈplɔɪ. ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈstriːt ˌfuːd? ɪz ɪt ˈseɪf tu ˈiːt?

passage.text: Kong shook his head. "I don't want to eat street food for a month!"
passage.reading: ˈkɔːŋ ˈʃʊk hɪz ˈhɛd. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈwɑːnt tu ˈiːt ˈstriːt ˌfuːd fər ə ˈmʌnθ!

passage.text: There was a long disagreement, and nobody wanted to give up.
passage.reading: ðɛr wʌz ə ˈlɔːŋ ˌdɪsəˈɡriːmənt, ənd ˈnoʊbɑːdi ˈwɑːntɪd tə ˈɡɪv ˈʌp.

passage.text: "What about air pollution? Traffic is one of the causes, and street food sellers breathe dirty air all day."
passage.reading: ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈɛr pəˈluːʃən? ˈtræfɪk ɪz ˈwʌn əv ðə ˈkɔːzɪz, ənd ˈstriːt ˌfuːd ˈsɛlərz ˈbriːð ˈdɜːrti ˈɛr ˈɔːl ˈdeɪ.

passage.text: "That includes both of our ideas," said Ploy. "I'll go along with that."
passage.reading: ðæt ɪnˈkluːdz ˈboʊθ əv aʊr aɪˈdiːəz, ˈsɛd ˈplɔɪ. aɪl ˈɡoʊ əˈlɔːŋ wɪð ˈðæt.

passage.text: "Fine," said Kong, "as long as I don't have to eat anything!"
passage.reading: ˈfaɪn, ˈsɛd ˈkɔːŋ, əz ˈlɔːŋ əz aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈhæf tu ˈiːt ˈɛniθɪŋ!

passage.text: In the end, the disagreement helped them, because together they found a better topic.
passage.reading: ɪn ði ˈɛnd, ðə ˌdɪsəˈɡriːmənt ˈhɛlpt ðɛm, bɪˈkɔːz təˈɡɛðər ðeɪ ˈfaʊnd ə ˈbɛtər ˈtɑːpɪk.

passage.text: And Mr. Brown loved their presentation.
passage.reading: ənd ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn ˈlʌvd ðɛr ˌprɛzənˈteɪʃən.
